article.story: CHARLOTTE, N.C. -- — Miles Sadler and Finley Bizjack each scored 15 points to help West Virginia beat North Carolina 72-59 on Friday night at the Dick Vitale Invitational. Javan Buchanan had 11 points and eight rebounds for West Virginia (5-2) and Joson Sanon also scored 11. The Mountaineers, who lead the series with North Carolina 6-0, never trailed. Bizjack and Sanon hit back-to-back 3-pointers to cap a 10-2 opening run and the Mountaineers scored nine consecutive points to push their lead to 16 points when Sanon made another 3 with 2:22 left until halftime. West Virginia had eight steals in the first half as the scored 10 points off 10 UNC turnovers to take a 41-30 lead into halftime. Maximo Adams led North Carolina (5-2) with 16 points. Jaydon Young scored 13 and Matt Able 12. Somerville hit a 3 and followed with a jumper that gave the Mountaineers their biggest lead at 58-39 with 9:53 left in the game, but Able answered with a 3-pointer and Adams converted a three-point play before Able hit two more 3s in a 12-0 run that trimmed the deficit to seven points with 7:28 to go. North Carolina got no closer as Sadler, Bizjack and Buchanan hit consecutive 3s that made it 67-41 and it was a double-digit lead the rest of the way. The Mountaineers outscored UNC 13-2 from the free-throw line and finished with 28 points off 20 Tar Heels turnovers. Up next North Carolina: Hosts Arkansas on Tuesday as part of the SEC/ACC Men’s Challenge.
